items.title: Kobe Sanders on Keaton Wagler: “First, we gotta start, he’s a hell of a player. ... He’s only 19 years old, so there’s gonna be ups and downs. The potential he has and the talent he has right now, he’s gonna be a hell of a player, so we’re just trying to build off of that.”
